summary: The card header and button colors unexpectedly changed from the primary blue brand style to a dark grey theme, which contradicts the design intent of only updating card text.

regressions.explanation: The card header background color changed from primary blue (rgb(13, 110, 253)) to grey (rgb(108, 117, 125)), which is an unintended visual change given the design intent.
regressions.violated_rule: Prefer Bootstrap's semantic CSS variables and maintain consistent card header styling across PrairieLearn UI.

regressions.explanation: The '+ Add course' button styling changed to dark grey with white text instead of maintaining standard button contrast and styling for card header actions.
regressions.violated_rule: Maintain consistent control styling and contrast for header actions.
